Last week, late winter greetings
Kudos to the whole crew

Travel care that keeps tails calm

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways had a steady stretch, with the team keeping check-ins smooth and the little details handled with care. The safety coordinator stayed close to the plan, watching for hazards and making sure each pet had patient attention from the trained staff. <<FACT F028>> Travelers appreciated the calm pace, and the records stayed neat and easy to follow.

There was also a good rhythm at the pet relief stop, where the staff helped families settle in without fuss. <<FACT F017>> The crew kept things friendly, and every handoff felt thoughtful. <<FACT F008>> It was a reassuring week all around, and the desk is ready to keep that steady support going for every trip.
